content: This paper presents a new method for simultaneously selecting important features and classifying functional/longitudinal data with categorical outcomes, using an adaptive optimization algorithm based on functional principal components and the Dual Augmented Lagrangian approach. The method is computationally efficient for high-dimensional data (where features outnumber samples) and is validated through simulations and real-world analysis of relationships between chronic diseases and health/socio-demographic factors.
